summary: Iteration 3 verified: 22/22 backend pytest cases passed (services INR + Signature Facial=1899, 8 services with currency=INR, membership plans 499/999/1999 INR, /professionals/categories returns 10 expected categories, professional register succeeds with valid category, missing category => 422 Pydantic, invalid category => 400, payments/checkout persists currency='inr'; plus all 14 iteration-2 regression tests still pass). issues: Switcher is a DropdownMenu — the trigger must be clicked first to reveal lang-en/lang-hi items. Not a bug, but note for automation.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is ~960 lines — still worth splitting into routers (services/memberships/professionals/payments/admin/chat).

Startup re-seed logic only checks first service currency != 'INR' to trigger reseed; if a manual doc is inserted with USD but not first, mixed currency will persist. Consider updating all rows via updateMany or checking count of non-INR docs.
VALID_PRO_CATEGORIES is a set; response is sorted list — good. But there is no i18n for category labels on backend (frontend only). Minor.
Payment transaction 'currency' hardcoded 'inr' at two places — extract into a constant.
RegisterProfessional.js relies on sonner toasts for validation feedback; consider inline field errors under RadioGroup for accessibility.
